cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(cui_questionnaire_geometry_worker C CXX)
enable_testing()
get_filename_component(CUI_SOURCE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../.." ABSOLUTE)
set(CUI_BUILD_NATIVE OFF CACHE BOOL "Portable worker fixture" FORCE)
add_subdirectory("${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}" cui)
add_executable(test_questionnaire_geometry "${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/unit/test_questionnaire_geometry.c")
target_link_libraries(test_questionnaire_geometry PRIVATE cui)
cui_warnings(test_questionnaire_geometry)
add_test(NAME questionnaire_geometry COMMAND test_questionnaire_geometry)
add_library(questionnaire_geometry_header OBJECT header.cpp)
target_include_directories(questionnaire_geometry_header PRIVATE "${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}/include")
cui_warnings(questionnaire_geometry_header)

add_library(questionnaire_geometry_guide OBJECT guide.c)
target_link_libraries(questionnaire_geometry_guide PRIVATE cui)
cui_warnings(questionnaire_geometry_guide)
